heroSummary: West Ada starts the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 12, with a late start. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, Winter Break December 21–January 1, and Spring Break March 15–19. Seniors finish May 14, ECSE preschool ends May 19, and the district’s last day of school is May 20. Families with middle or high school students should also use the district’s separate A/B calendars.

definitions.description: West Ada’s live calendar identifies the first day as a late-start day. Check your school’s bell schedule for the exact start time.
Grades K–8 have no school September 25. They also have no school for conferences October 8, while grades 9–12 remain in session and hold evening conferences.
The ECSE calendar says preschool does not meet on Fridays. Its last day is May 19, one day before the K–12 calendar ends.
Seniors finish May 14. From May 17–20, advisory moves to the end of the high school day, while the overall start and end times remain unchanged.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: The first day moves from August 13 to August 12 and is identified as a late-start day on the live district calendar.
September 25 adds a teacher-preparation closure for grades K-8; grades 9-12 are not listed as off.
Thanksgiving Break and Spring Break both begin one day earlier than in 2025–26, but each still covers five weekdays.
Seniors finish May 14, and the districtwide last day moves two days earlier to May 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When does West Ada start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day is Wednesday, August 12, 2026. West Ada's live calendar identifies it as a late-start day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is West Ada Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 15–19, 2027, and school resumes March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: Do West Ada high school students have September 25 or October 8 off?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists both dates as no school for grades K-8. Grades 9-12 are not listed as off, and they remain in session October 8 with evening conferences.

calendarFaqs.q: Does ECSE preschool meet on Fridays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The 2026–27 ECSE calendar says preschool does not meet on Fridays. The preschool last day is May 19.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find West Ada A/B days?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official high school or middle school A/B PDF. Each file assigns an A or B rotation to instructional dates and includes grade-level bell times.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for West Ada seniors?
calendarFaqs.a: Seniors finish Friday, May 14, 2027. Other K-12 students finish May 20.
